## Load input data

```{r}
# load VCF using rCNV::readVCF (for genotyping file conversion)
vcf_rcnv_datasets <- lapply(vcf_location, readVCF)

# load VCF using vcfR::read.vcfR (to write final datasets)
vcf_vcfr_dataset <- lapply(vcf_location, read.vcfR)

# load sample/population info file

  pop_ind_file_location, 
  \(x) read.delim(x, header = F, col.names = c("sample", "population"))
```

## Define other parameters

```{R}
contrast_key <-
  data.frame(
    CONTRAST = as.character(1:3),
    ContrastName = c(
      "SSF x LoA",
      "SSF x LoA_N",
      "SSF x LoA_F"
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(

        )
      )
    )

contrast_key
```


# PREPARING INPUT FILES

## Genotyping file formatting

Convert VCF data into `.baypass` format (two allele count columns per sampling location, each row a SNP) using funtions `genotypeTable()` and `gt.format()` from package `rCNV`.

```{r}
#| output: false
# extract genotype table using rCNV::hetTgen
genotype_tables <- lapply(
  vcf_rcnv_datasets,
  \(x) hetTgen(x, "GT")
  )

# transform genotype table into .baypass
baypass_gen_data <- lapply( 
  set_names(c("AND", "BOM", "LGL"), c("AND", "BOM", "LGL")),
  \(x) gt.format(genotype_tables[[x]], pop_ind_table[[x]], format = "bpass")
  )

```

Check if *BayPass* table was formatted correctly.

```{r}
# number of rows should match the number of SNPs in the dataset
# number of columns should be twice the number of sampling locations
dim(baypass_gen_data[["AND"]]$baypass)
dim(baypass_gen_data[["BOM"]]$baypass)
dim(baypass_gen_data[["LGL"]]$baypass)

# check if column names are in correct order
# this order must match that in the env file!
colnames(baypass_gen_data[["AND"]]$baypass)
colnames(baypass_gen_data[["BOM"]]$baypass)
colnames(baypass_gen_data[["LGL"]]$baypass)
```

# RUN *BAYPASS*

Run`Baypass`, using the XtXst and C2 statistics.

# ANDRENA FLAVIPES

### Core model analysis

#### Setup Baypass run

```{r}
AND_baypass_setup_info <- baypass_run_setup(
  executable_path = "/home/dau2/software/baypass_public-master_3.0/sources/g_baypass",
  baypass_utils_path = "/home/dau2/software/baypass_public-master_3.0/utils/baypass_utils.R",
  popfile_path = "/mnt/data2/Project_Polli_agro/Operational/2_metadata/02_SSF_samples/01_sample_files/AND_popmap_baypass.txt",
  envfile_path = "contrast_files/AND_contrast_file.txt",
  contrast_path = "contrast_files/AND_contrast_file.txt",
  genofile_path = "01_intermediate_files/AND_stk_rm_assafora_minDP5_minGQ30_bi_mac02_meanDP10-100_maxmiss20_thinned300bp.baypass",
  output_path = "2_BAYPASS_output/",
  run_prefix = "AND_run_baypass_300bp",
  n_pops = 13,
  seeds = "7357",
  thread_number = 8
)
```

Store setup information.

```{r}
saveRDS(
  AND_baypass_setup_info,
  "03_results/R_data/AND_run_baypass_300bp.RDS.bz2",
  compress = "bzip2"
  )
```

AND SNP metadata.

```{R}
AND_SNP_metadata <- 
  vcf_vcfr_dataset[["AND"]]@fix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(CHROM, POS) %>% 
  mutate(
    MRK = 1:nrow(.),
    CHROM_number = as.double(str_extract(CHROM, "\\d")),
    CHROM_color = case_when(
      CHROM_number %% 2 == 0 ~ "even",
      .default = "odd"
      )
    )
```


#### Run analysis

Run core model using wrapper function `core_mode_wrapper()`:

```{r}
AND_core_mode_results <- 
  core_mode_wrapper(AND_baypass_setup_info, skip_baypass = T)
```

#### Source Baypass utils

```{R}
source(AND_baypass_setup_info$paths$baypass_utils_path)
```

### Check p-value behaviour

We need to check if the p-values are well-behaved or not.

If not, we need to run the POD calibration as described in the BayPass v.3.0. manual.

#### XtXst estimator

Visualize the estimates of the XtXst differentiation measures.

Check behavior of the p-values associated to the XtXst estimator.

```{r}
lapply(
  AND_baypass_setup_info$run_info$seeds,
  \(x) AND_core_mode_results[["xtx_estimator"]][[x]] %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = 10**(-1 * log10.1.pval.), y = ..density..)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50, boundary = 0) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1) +
    ggtitle(paste("Seed", x))
  )

```

##### [OPTIONAL] Correcting for multiple testing

When correcting for multiple testing, p-values should be converted in q-values

Setting FDR (False Discovery Rate) = 0.05 or 0.01

```{r}
AND_xtx_qvalues <-
  lapply(
    AND_baypass_setup_info$run_info$seeds,
    \(x) AND_core_mode_results[["xtx_estimator"]][[x]] %>% 
      mutate(pval =  10**(-1 * log10.1.pval.)) %>% 
      pull(pval) %>% 
      qvalue(fdr.level = 0.05)
    )
```

Print the summary for every seed

```{r}
invisible(
  Map(
    \(seed, qobj) {
      cat("\n#####  Seed:", seed, "#####\n")
      print(summary(qobj))
      },
      AND_baypass_setup_info$run_info$seeds,   # names / labels
      AND_xtx_qvalues                          # corresponding q-value objects
    )
  )
```

## Simulate the POD dataset

```{r}

# Estimate beta parameters for the Pi distribution
AND_pi_beta <- AND_core_mode_results$pi_beta_coef[["7357"]]$Mean

# Extract allele counts from your original .baypass genotype file
AND_allele_data <- geno2YN(AND_baypass_setup_info$paths$genofile)

# Simulate 30,000 SNPs based on the estimated parameters
simulate.baypass(
  omega.mat = AND_core_mode_results$omega_matrix[["7357"]],
  nsnp = 68799,
  sample.size = AND_allele_data$NN,
  beta.pi = AND_pi_beta,
  pi.maf = 0,
  suffix = "AND_POD_mac2_300bp_window"
)
```

#### Set up the BayPass POD run

```{r}

AND_POD_setup_info <- baypass_run_setup(
  executable_path = "/home/dau2/software/baypass_public-master_3.0/sources/g_baypass",
  baypass_utils_path = "/home/dau2/software/baypass_public-master_3.0/utils/baypass_utils.R",
  popfile_path = "/mnt/data2/Project_Polli_agro/Operational/2_metadata/02_SSF_samples/01_sample_files/AND_popmap_baypass.txt",
  envfile_path = "contrast_files/AND_contrast_file.txt",
  contrast_path = "contrast_files/AND_contrast_file.txt",
  genofile_path = "2_BAYPASS_output/AND_POD_run_analysis_output/0_core_mode_output/G.AND_POD_mac2_300bp_window",
  output_path = "2_BAYPASS_output/AND_POD_run_analysis_output/0_core_mode_output/seed_7357_mac2_300bp_window/",
  run_prefix = "AND_POD_mac2_300bp_window_run",
  n_pops = 13,
  seeds = "7357",
  thread_number = 8
)
```

#### Save the setup

```{r}
names(AND_POD_xtxst_thresholds)
```

### Analyze `Baypass` results

#### Check convergence of the covariance matrix

Calculate correlation between the posterior means of the estimated Omega matrix elements across independent runs.

```{R}
AND_core_mode_results$lda_omega %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "seed") %>%
  mutate(comparison = paste0(I, " - ", J)) %>% 
  select(comparison, seed, M_omega_ij) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = M_omega_ij) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("comparison") %>% 
  cor() 
```

Visualize covariance matrix using SVD decomposition:

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 15

plot.omega(
  omega = AND_core_mode_results[["omega_matrix"]][["7357"]],
  pop.names = AND_core_mode_results[["pop_names"]]
)
```

Visualize covariance matrix as a correlation plot:

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 15

# Convert to correlation matrix
corr_mat <- cov2cor(
  AND_core_mode_results[["omega_matrix"]][["7357"]]
)

# Plot correlation
corrplot(
  corr_mat,
  method = "color",
  mar = c(2, 1, 2, 2) + 0.1,
  main = expression("Correlation map based on" ~ hat(Omega))
)
```

Visualize covariance matrix as a heatmap:

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 15
heatmap(
  1 - corr_mat,
  hclustfun = \(x) hclust(x, method = "average"),
  main = expression("Heatmap of " ~ hat(Omega) ~ "(" * d[ij] * "=1-" * rho[ij] * ")")
)
```

Visualize covariance matrix as hierarchical clustering tree:

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 15
plot(
  as.phylo(
    hclust(
      as.dist(1 - corr_mat**2)
    )
  ),
  type = "p",
  main = expression(
    "Hier. clust. tree based on" ~ hat(Omega) ~ "(" * d[ij] * "=1-" * rho[ij] * ")"
  )
)
```

#### XtXst estimator

##### XtXst outliers

Visualize the outliers from the XtXst in the original data using the calculated qvalues.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 15

fdr_thresh <- 0.01

pdf("03_results/graphs/XtX/AND_XtXst_Manhattan_plots", width = 15, height = 10)

# Loop through all seeds and plot
invisible(
  lapply(
    AND_baypass_setup_info$run_info$seeds,
    function(seed) {
      # 1. Get SNP table
      snp_data <- AND_core_mode_results[["xtx_estimator"]][[seed]]
      
      # 2. Get qvalue object for this seed
      qobj <- AND_xtx_qvalues[[seed]]
      
      # 3. Add q-values and outlier flag to SNP table
      snp_data <- snp_data %>%
        mutate(
          qval = qobj$qvalues,
          log10qval = -log10(qval),
          is_outlier = case_when(
            qval <= fdr_thresh ~ "outlier",
            .default = "not outlier"
          )
        ) %>%
        left_join(AND_SNP_metadata, by = "MRK")
      
      # 4. Create and print the plot to the PDF
      print(
        ggplot(snp_data, aes(x = MRK, y = log10qval, color = CHROM_color, size = is_outlier)) +
          geom_point() +
          geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_thresh), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
          scale_color_manual(values = c("odd" = "black", "even" = "grey")) +
          scale_size_manual(values = c("outlier" = 2, "not outlier" = 1)) +
          labs(
            title = paste("XtX q-values (Seed", seed, ")"),
            x = "SNP (MRK)",
            y = expression(-log[10](q~value))
          ) +
          guides(color = "none", size = "none") +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
      )
    }
  )
)

# Close the PDF
dev.off()
```

##### Extract outliers in a list

```{r}

AND_xtxst_outliers_per_seed <- lapply(
  names(AND_xtx_qvalues),
  function(seed) {
    qobj <- AND_xtx_qvalues[[seed]]
    real_data <- AND_core_mode_results$xtx_estimator[[seed]]
    real_data$MRK[qobj$qvalues <= fdr_thresh]
  }
) %>% setNames(names(AND_xtx_qvalues))

AND_xtxst_common_outliers <- Reduce(intersect, AND_xtxst_outliers_per_seed)
length(AND_xtxst_common_outliers)

pdf("03_results/graphs/XtX/AND_XtXst_outliers_VennDiagram.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)

print(
  ggVennDiagram(
    AND_xtxst_outliers_per_seed, 
    label = "count",
    label_geom = "text",
    label_color = "white"
  ) +
    labs(title = "Overlap of XtXst Outliers (q-value ≤ 0.01) Across Seeds")
)

dev.off()
```

#### C2 Statistic

##### Check convergence of the covariance matrix

Calculate correlation between C2 statistics of different runs.

```{R}
AND_core_mode_results$contrast %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "seed") %>%
  mutate(comparison = paste0(CONTRAST, " - ", MRK)) %>% 
  select(comparison, seed, C2) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = C2) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("comparison") %>% 
  cor() 
```

##### C2 outliers

Extract outliers by keeping only those above the threshold in every seed.

```{r}
# Open a new PDF device
pdf("03_results/Contrast_analysis/AND/AND_C2_statistic_Manhattan_plots_300bp.pdf", width = 15, height = 10)

names(AND_POD_C2_thresholds)

# Loop through all seeds
invisible(
  lapply(
    AND_baypass_setup_info$run_info$seeds,
    function(seed) {
      
      # 1. Get C2 data for this seed
      AND_snp_data <- AND_core_mode_results[["contrast"]][[seed]]
      
      # 2. Get threshold for this seed
      AND_c2_thresh <- AND_POD_C2_thresholds[[as.character(seed)]]

      # 3. Add outlier flag to SNP table based on M_C2 and C2 threshold
      AND_snp_data <- AND_snp_data %>%
        mutate(
            is_outlier = case_when(
            C2 >= c2_thresh ~ "outlier",
            TRUE ~ "not outlier"
  ),
          CONTRAST = as.character(CONTRAST)
        ) %>%
        left_join(AND_SNP_metadata, by = "MRK") %>%
        left_join(contrast_key, by = "CONTRAST")  # Add contrast names

      # 4. Plot using ContrastName
      print(
        ggplot(AND_snp_data, aes(x = MRK, y = C2, color = CHROM_color, size = is_outlier)) +
          geom_point() +
          geom_hline(yintercept = c2_thresh, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
          scale_color_manual(values = c("odd" = "black", "even" = "grey")) +
          scale_size_manual(values = c("outlier" = 2, "not outlier" = 1)) +
          facet_wrap(~ ContrastName, scales = "free_x", ncol = 1) +  # Use readable names
          labs(
            title = paste("C2 statistic (Seed", seed, ")"),
            x = "SNP (MRK)",
            y = "C2 value"
          ) +
          guides(color = "none", size = "none") +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
      )
    }
  )
)

# Close the PDF device
dev.off()

```

###### Extract total C2 outliers for each contrast in a list

```{r}

# 1. Get the C2 data for seed 7357
AND_C2_snp_data <- AND_core_mode_results[["contrast"]][["7357"]]

# 2. Get the threshold (99th percentile from PODs)
AND_c2_thresh <- as.numeric(AND_POD_C2_thresholds["7357"])

# 3. Filter SNPs that are outliers
AND_C2_outliers_7357 <- AND_C2_snp_data %>%
  filter(C2 >= AND_c2_thresh)

# Optional: just get vector of SNP IDs (MRK)
AND_C2_outlier_ids_7357 <- AND_C2_outliers_7357$MRK

# Optional: save to CSV
write.csv(AND_C2_outliers_7357, "03_results/Contrast_analysis/AND/AND_C2_outliers_seed7357_300bp.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

###### Venn Diagram for the C2 statistic of the 3 contrasts


##### BF outliers

```{R}
# Set seed to plot
seed <- "7357"

# BF threshold for decisive evidence (e.g. Jeffreys’ rule)
bf_thresh <- 10

# Read BF values (6 contrasts × N SNPs)
AND_bf_data <- AND_core_mode_results$betai_reg[[seed]]$BF.dB.
AND_n_contrasts <- length(unique(contrast_key$CONTRAST))
AND_n_snps <- length(AND_bf_data) / AND_n_contrasts

# Create tibble with BF per SNP and contrast
AND_BF_df <- tibble(
  MRK = rep(1:AND_n_snps, times = AND_n_contrasts),
  CONTRAST = as.character(rep(1:AND_n_contrasts, each = AND_n_snps)),
  BF = AND_bf_data
) %>%
  mutate(
    is_outlier = ifelse(BF >= bf_thresh, "outlier", "not outlier")
  ) %>%
  left_join(AND_SNP_metadata, by = "MRK") %>%
  left_join(contrast_key, by = "CONTRAST")

# Save to PDF
pdf("03_results/Contrast_analysis/AND/AND_BF_statistic_Manhattan_plot_seed7357_300bp.pdf", width = 15, height = 10)

# Plot
print(
  ggplot(AND_BF_df, aes(x = MRK, y = BF, color = CHROM_color, size = is_outlier)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = bf_thresh, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("odd" = "black", "even" = "grey")) +
    scale_size_manual(values = c("outlier" = 2, "not outlier" = 1)) +
    facet_wrap(~ ContrastName, scales = "free_x", ncol = 1) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Bayes Factor (BF) Statistic – Seed", seed),
      x = "SNP (MRK)",
      y = "BF (dB)"
    ) +
    guides(color = "none", size = "none") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
)

dev.off()
```

#### C2 vs BF plot

```{R}
#|figfig-width: 10
#|figfig-height: 15
# Set seed
seed <- "7357"

# Load BF data for this seed
AND_bf_file <- file.path(
  "/mnt/data2/Project_Polli_agro/Operational/4_data_analysis/7_seldetection/baypass/2_BAYPASS_output/AND_run_baypass_300bp_analysis_output/0_core_mode_output/",
  paste0("seed_", seed),
  paste0("AND_run_baypass_300bp_seed", seed, "_core_summary_betai_reg.out")
)

AND_BF_values <- read.table(AND_bf_file, header = TRUE)$BF.dB.
AND_n_snps <- length(AND_BF_values)
AND_n_contrasts <- 3

AND_BF_table <- tibble(
  MRK = rep(1:(AND_n_snps / AND_n_contrasts), times = AND_n_contrasts),
  CONTRAST = as.character(rep(1:AND_n_contrasts, each = AND_n_snps / AND_n_contrasts)),
  BF = AND_BF_values
) %>%
  left_join(contrast_key, by = "CONTRAST")

# Load C2 values
AND_C2_table <- AND_core_mode_results[["contrast"]][[seed]] %>%
  mutate(
    CONTRAST = as.character(CONTRAST),
    log10p = log10.1.pval.
  ) %>%
  left_join(contrast_key, by = "CONTRAST") %>%
  select(MRK, ContrastName, C2, log10p)

# Combine BF and C2 values
AND_C2_BF_combined <- AND_C2_table %>%
  left_join(AND_BF_table, by = c("MRK", "ContrastName"))

# Add outlier flags using empirical threshold
AND_C2_threshold <- as.numeric(AND_POD_C2_thresholds[seed])

AND_C2_BF_combined <- AND_C2_BF_combined %>%
  mutate(
    C2_outlier = C2 >= C2_threshold,
    BF_outlier = BF >= 10,
    both_outlier = C2_outlier & BF_outlier
  )

# Optional: extract only double outliers
AND_C2_BF_outliers_7357 <- AND_C2_BF_combined %>% filter(both_outlier)

# Plot
plot_path <- "03_results/C2_BF/AND_seed7357_BF_vs_C2_300bp_plot.pdf"
dir.create(dirname(plot_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggplot(AND_C2_BF_combined, aes(x = BF, y = C2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = both_outlier), alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ ContrastName, ncol = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = C2_threshold, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 10, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "red", "FALSE" = "black")) +
  labs(
    title = "Bayes Factor vs C2 Statistic (Seed 7357)",
    subtitle = "Red = Outliers for BOTH BF and C2",
    x = "Bayes Factor (BF in dB)",
    y = "C2 Statistic"
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Outlier (BF & C2)")) +
  theme_minimal()

# Save plot
ggsave(plot_path, width = 10, height = 15)

# Join SNP metadata to include POS and CHROM info
AND_C2_BF_outliers_7357_position <- AND_C2_BF_outliers_7357 %>%
  left_join(AND_SNP_metadata, by = "MRK")

# Save updated CSV
write_csv(AND_C2_BF_outliers_7357_position, "03_results/C2_BF/AND_seed7357_C2_BF_300bp_outliers_with_POS.csv")
```

####### Extract common (UNION) C2 x BF outliers between contrasts in a list

```{R}
# Load main outlier table
AND_C2_BF_total_outliers <- read_csv("03_results/C2_BF/AND_seed7357_C2_BF_300bp_outliers.csv")

# Split by contrast
split_outliers <- split(AND_C2_BF_total_outliers, AND_C2_BF_total_outliers$ContrastName)

# Define helper function to merge and clean columns
# Helper to get common outliers and clean up column names
AND_extract_C2_BF_total_outliers <- function(df1, df2) {
  inner_join(df1, df2, by = "MRK", suffix = c(".1", ".2")) %>%
    transmute(
      MRK,
      ContrastName = ContrastName.1,
      C2 = C2.1,
      log10p = log10p.1,
      BF = BF.1,
      C2_outlier = C2_outlier.1,
      BF_outlier = BF_outlier.1,
      both_outlier = both_outlier.1
    )
}

# Compute pairwise intersections
AND_UNION_C2_BF_outlier_C1_C2  <- AND_extract_C2_BF_total_outliers(split_outliers[[1]], split_outliers[[2]])
AND_UNION_C2_BF_outlier_C1_C3 <- AND_extract_C2_BF_total_outliers(split_outliers[[1]], split_outliers[[3]])
AND_UNION_C2_BF_outlier_C2_C3 <- AND_extract_C2_BF_total_outliers(split_outliers[[2]], split_outliers[[3]])

# Export as CSV
write_csv(AND_UNION_C2_BF_outlier_C1_C2, "03_results/C2_BF/AND_C2_BF_common_outliers_C1_C2.csv")
write_csv(AND_UNION_C2_BF_outlier_C1_C3, "03_results/C2_BF/AND_C2_BF_common_outliers_C1_C3.csv")
write_csv(AND_UNION_C2_BF_outlier_C2_C3, "03_results/C2_BF/AND_C2_BF_common_outliers_C2_C3.csv")
```

#### Compute Local Scores

```{R}
# Set seed and contrast
seed <- "7357"
contrast_id <- "1"  # Use "1", "2", or "3"

# 1. SNP position info
AND_snp_position <- AND_SNP_metadata %>%
  select(CHROM, POS) %>%
  mutate(POS = as.numeric(POS)) 

# 2. Extract pi values (from summary_pi_xtx.out)
AND_snp_pi <- AND_core_mode_results$xtx_estimator[[seed]]$M_P

# 3. Extract p-values (from summary_contrast.out)
AND_snp_pvalues <- AND_core_mode_results$contrast[[seed]] %>%
  filter(CONTRAST == contrast_id) %>%
  pull(log10.1.pval.)

# 4. Compute local scores (and plot)
pdf(paste0("03_results/Local_scores/AND_local_scores_contrast_", contrast_id, "_seed", seed, "_300bp.pdf"),
    width = 10, height = 6)

AND_local_scores <- compute.local.scores(
  snp.position = AND_snp_position,
  snp.pi = AND_snp_pi,
  snp.pvalue = AND_snp_pvalues,
  manplot = TRUE,
  min.maf = 0.20,
  xi = 1,
  plot.pvalhist = TRUE
)

 # Save output tables from compute.local.scores
 write.csv(AND_local_scores$res.local.scores,
          file = paste0("03_results/Local_scores/AND_local_scores_contrast_", contrast_id, "_seed", seed, "_res_local_scores.csv"),
         row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(AND_local_scores$significant.windows,
          file = paste0("03_results/Local_scores/AND_local_scores_contrast_", contrast_id, "_seed", seed, "_significant_windows.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)


dev.off()
```

### Check P-value Behaviour

#### XtXst estimator

Visualize the estimates of the XtXst differentiation measures.

Check behavior of the p-values associated to the XtXst estimator.

```{r}
lapply(
  BOM_baypass_setup_info$run_info$seeds,
  \(x) BOM_core_mode_results[["xtx_estimator"]][[x]] %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = 10**(-1 * log10.1.pval.), y = ..density..)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50, boundary = 0) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1) +
    ggtitle(paste("Seed", x))
  )

```

Plot XtXst estimates and p-values

```{r}

layout(matrix(1:2, 2, 1))

for (seed in BOM_baypass_setup_info$run_info$seeds) {
  
  BOM_xtx_data <- BOM_core_mode_results[["xtx_estimator"]][[seed]]

  # Plot XtXst
  plot(
    BOM_xtx_data$XtXst,
    ylab = "XtXst",
    xlab = "SNP Index",
    main = paste("XtXst – Seed", seed),
    pch = 20
  )

  # Plot log10.1.pval.
  plot(
    BOM_xtx_data$log10.1.pval.,
    ylab = expression("XtX P-value (" * -log[10] * "(p))"),
    xlab = "SNP Index",
    main = paste("XtX P-values – Seed", seed),
    pch = 20
  )
  
  abline(h = 3, lty = 2, col = "red")  # log10(p = 0.001)
}
```

##### [OPTIONAL] Correcting for multiple testing

When correcting for multiple testing, p-values should be converted in q-values

Setting FDR (False Discovery Rate) = 0.05 or 0.01

```{r}
BOM_xtx_qvalues <-
  lapply(
    BOM_baypass_setup_info$run_info$seeds,
    \(x) BOM_core_mode_results[["xtx_estimator"]][[x]] %>% 
      mutate(pval =  10**(-1 * log10.1.pval.)) %>% 
      pull(pval) %>% 
      qvalue(fdr.level = 0.05)
    )
```

Print the summary for every seed

```{r}
invisible(
  Map(
    \(seed, qobj) {
      cat("\n#####  Seed:", seed, "#####\n")
      print(summary(qobj))
      },
      BOM_baypass_setup_info$run_info$seeds,   # names / labels
      BOM_xtx_qvalues                          # corresponding q-value objects
    )
  )
```

```{r}
simulate.baypass(
  omega.mat = BOM_core_mode_results$omega_matrix[["7357"]],

  sample.size = BOM_allele_data$NN,

)
```

### Analyze `Baypass` results

#### Check convergence of the covariance matrix

Calculate correlation between the posterior means of the estimated Omega matrix elements across independent runs.

```{R}
BOM_core_mode_results$lda_omega %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "seed") %>%
  mutate(comparison = paste0(I, " - ", J)) %>% 
  select(comparison, seed, M_omega_ij) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = M_omega_ij) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("comparison") %>% 
  cor() 
```

Visualize covariance matrix using SVD decomposition:

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 15

plot.omega(
  omega = BOM_core_mode_results[["omega_matrix"]][["7357"]],
  pop.names = BOM_core_mode_results[["pop_names"]]
)
```

Visualize covariance matrix as a correlation plot:

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 15

# Convert to correlation matrix
corr_mat <- cov2cor(
  BOM_core_mode_results[["omega_matrix"]][["7357"]]
)

# Plot correlation
corrplot(
  corr_mat,
  method = "color",
  mar = c(2, 1, 2, 2) + 0.1,
  main = expression("Correlation map based on" ~ hat(Omega))
)
```

Visualize covariance matrix as a heatmap:

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 15
heatmap(
  1 - corr_mat,
  hclustfun = \(x) hclust(x, method = "average"),
  main = expression("Heatmap of " ~ hat(Omega) ~ "(" * d[ij] * "=1-" * rho[ij] * ")")
)
```

Visualize covariance matrix as hierarchical clustering tree:

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 15
plot(
  as.phylo(
    hclust(
      as.dist(1 - corr_mat**2)
    )
  ),
  type = "p",
  main = expression(
    "Hier. clust. tree based on" ~ hat(Omega) ~ "(" * d[ij] * "=1-" * rho[ij] * ")"
  )
)
```

#### XtXst estimator

##### XtXst outliers

Visualize the outliers from the XtXst in the original data using the POD threshold. 

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 15

BOM_SNP_metadata <- 
  vcf_vcfr_dataset[["BOM"]]@fix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(CHROM, POS) %>% 
  mutate(
    MRK = 1:n(),
    CHROM_number = as.numeric(str_extract(CHROM, "\\d+")),
    CHROM_color = case_when(
      CHROM_number %% 2 == 0 ~ "even",
      TRUE ~ "odd"
    )
  )

names(BOM_POD_xtxst_thresholds) <- as.character(BOM_baypass_setup_info$run_info$seeds)

BOM_xtxst_manhattan_plots <- lapply(
  BOM_baypass_setup_info$run_info$seeds,
  function(seed) {
    # 1. Get BayPass results for this seed
    snp_data <- BOM_core_mode_results[["xtx_estimator"]][[seed]]
    
    # 2. Get corresponding threshold from POD
    threshold <- BOM_POD_xtxst_thresholds[[as.character(seed)]]
    
    # 3. Annotate with outlier flag + SNP metadata
    snp_data <- snp_data %>%
      mutate(
        is_outlier = ifelse(XtXst >= threshold, "outlier", "not outlier")
      ) %>%
      left_join(BOM_SNP_metadata, by = "MRK")
    
    # 4. Manhattan plot
    ggplot(snp_data, aes(x = MRK, y = XtXst, color = CHROM_color, size = is_outlier)) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_hline(yintercept = threshold, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("odd" = "black", "even" = "grey")) +
      scale_size_manual(values = c("outlier" = 2, "not outlier" = 0.5)) +
      labs(
        title = paste("XtXst Manhattan Plot – Seed", seed),
        subtitle = paste("Threshold from POD:", round(threshold, 3)),
        x = "SNP (MRK)",
        y = "XtXst"
      ) +
      guides(color = "none", size = "none") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
  }
)

names(BOM_POD_xtxst_thresholds) <- as.character(BOM_baypass_setup_info$run_info$seeds)

# Print the plots

for (plot in BOM_xtxst_manhattan_plots) {
  print(plot)
}

# Save to a PDF

pdf("03_results/graphs/BOM_XtXst_Manhattan_plots", width = 12, height = 6)

for (p in BOM_xtxst_manhattan_plots) {
  print(p)
}

dev.off()
```

##### Calculate Median XtXst

Calculate median XtXst per MRK across seeds.

```{R}
BOM_median_XtXst <- BOM_core_mode_results$xtx_estimator %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "seed") %>%
  select(seed, MRK, XtXst) %>% 
  summarise(Median_XtXst = median(XtXst), .by = MRK) %>% 
  mutate(
    is_outlier = ifelse(Median_XtXst >= BOM_POD_xtxst_thresholds[1] , "outlier", "not outlier")
    )
```

#### C2 Statistic

##### Check convergence of the covariance matrix

Calculate correlation between C2 statistics of different runs.

```{R}
BOM_core_mode_results$contrast %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "seed") %>%
  mutate(comparison = paste0(CONTRAST, " - ", MRK)) %>% 
  select(comparison, seed, C2) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = C2) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("comparison") %>% 
  cor() 
```

```{R}
# Set seed to plot

  MRK = rep(1:BOM_n_snps, times = BOM_n_contrasts),
```

#### C2 vs BF plot

```{R}
#|figfig-width: 10
#|figfig-height: 15
# Set seed
seed <- "7357"

# Load BF data for this seed
BOM_bf_file <- file.path(
  "/mnt/data2/Project_Polli_agro/Operational/4_data_analysis/7_seldetection/baypass/2_BAYPASS_output/BOM_run_baypass_300bp_analysis_output/0_core_mode_output/",
  paste0("seed_", seed),
  paste0("BOM_run_baypass_300bp_seed", seed, "_core_summary_betai_reg.out")
)

BOM_bf_values <- read.table(BOM_bf_file, header = TRUE)$BF.dB.
BOM_n_snps <- length(BOM_bf_values)
BOM_n_contrasts <- 3

BOM_BF_table <- tibble(
  MRK = rep(1:(BOM_n_snps / BOM_n_contrasts), times = BOM_n_contrasts),
  CONTRAST = as.character(rep(1:BOM_n_contrasts, each = BOM_n_snps / BOM_n_contrasts)),
  BF = BOM_bf_values
) %>%
  left_join(contrast_key, by = "CONTRAST")

# Load C2 values
BOM_C2_table <- BOM_core_mode_results[["contrast"]][[seed]] %>%
  mutate(
    CONTRAST = as.character(CONTRAST),
    log10p = log10.1.pval.
  ) %>%
  left_join(contrast_key, by = "CONTRAST") %>%
  select(MRK, ContrastName, C2, log10p)

# Combine BF and C2 values
BOM_C2_BF_combined <- BOM_C2_table %>%
  left_join(BOM_BF_table, by = c("MRK", "ContrastName"))

# Add outlier flags using empirical threshold
BOM_C2_threshold <- as.numeric(BOM_POD_C2_thresholds[seed])

BOM_C2_BF_combined <- BOM_C2_BF_combined %>%
  mutate(
    C2_outlier = C2 >= C2_threshold,
    BF_outlier = BF >= 10,
    both_outlier = C2_outlier & BF_outlier
  )

# Optional: extract only double outliers
BOM_C2_BF_outliers_7357 <- BOM_C2_BF_combined %>% filter(both_outlier)

# Plot
plot_path <- "03_results/C2_BF/BOM_seed7357_BF_vs_C2_300bp_plot.pdf"
dir.create(dirname(plot_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggplot(BOM_C2_BF_combined, aes(x = BF, y = C2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = both_outlier), alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ ContrastName, ncol = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = C2_threshold, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 10, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "red", "FALSE" = "black")) +
  labs(
    title = "Bayes Factor vs C2 Statistic (Seed 7357 – AND)",
    subtitle = "Red = Outliers for BOTH BF and C2",
    x = "Bayes Factor (BF in dB)",
    y = "C2 Statistic"
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Outlier (BF & C2)")) +
  theme_minimal()

# Save plot
ggsave(plot_path, width = 10, height = 15)

# Join SNP metadata to include POS and CHROM info
BOM_C2_BF_outliers_7357_position <- BOM_C2_BF_outliers_7357 %>%
  left_join(BOM_SNP_metadata, by = "MRK")

# Save updated CSV
write_csv(BOM_C2_BF_outliers_7357_position, "03_results/C2_BF/BOM_seed7357_C2_BF_300bp_outliers_with_POS.csv")
```

####### Extract common (UNION) C2 x BF outliers between contrasts in a list

```{R}
# Load main outlier table
BOM_C2_BF_total_outliers <- read_csv("03_results/C2_BF/BOM_seed7357_C2_BF_300bp_outliers.csv")

# Split by contrast
split_outliers <- split(BOM_C2_BF_total_outliers, BOM_C2_BF_total_outliers$ContrastName)

# Define helper function to merge BOM clean columns
# Helper to get common outliers BOM clean up column names
BOM_extract_C2_BF_total_outliers <- function(df1, df2) {
  inner_join(df1, df2, by = "MRK", suffix = c(".1", ".2")) %>%
    transmute(
      MRK,
      ContrastName = ContrastName.1,
      C2 = C2.1,
      log10p = log10p.1,
      BF = BF.1,
      C2_outlier = C2_outlier.1,
      BF_outlier = BF_outlier.1,
      both_outlier = both_outlier.1
    )
}

# Compute pairwise intersections
BOM_UNION_C2_BF_outlier_C1_C2  <- BOM_extract_C2_BF_total_outliers(split_outliers[[1]], split_outliers[[2]])
BOM_UNION_C2_BF_outlier_C1_C3 <- BOM_extract_C2_BF_total_outliers(split_outliers[[1]], split_outliers[[3]])
BOM_UNION_C2_BF_outlier_C2_C3 <- BOM_extract_C2_BF_total_outliers(split_outliers[[2]], split_outliers[[3]])

# Export as CSV
write_csv(BOM_UNION_C2_BF_outlier_C1_C2, "03_results/C2_BF/BOM_C2_BF_common_outliers_C1_C2.csv")
write_csv(BOM_UNION_C2_BF_outlier_C1_C3, "03_results/C2_BF/BOM_C2_BF_common_outliers_C1_C3.csv")
write_csv(BOM_UNION_C2_BF_outlier_C2_C3, "03_results/C2_BF/BOM_C2_BF_common_outliers_C2_C3.csv")
```

```{R}
# Set seed BOM contrast

  select(CHROM, POS) %>%
  mutate(POS = as.numeric(POS)) %>%
  arrange(POS)

  filter(CONTRAST == contrast_id) %>%
  pull(log10.1.pval.)

# 4. Compute local scores (BOM plot)
pdf(paste0("03_results/Local_scores/BOM_local_scores_contrast_", contrast_id, "_seed", seed, "_300bp.pdf"),
    width = 10, height = 6)

BOM_local_scores <- compute.local.scores(
  snp.position = BOM_snp_position,
  snp.pi = BOM_snp_pi,

  min.maf = 0.20,
  xi = 1,
  min.nsnp = 0,

)

 # Save output tables from compute.local.scores
 write.csv(BOM_local_scores$res.local.scores,
          file = paste0("03_results/Local_scores/BOM_local_scores_contrast_", contrast_id, "_seed", seed, "_res_local_scores.csv"),
         row.names = FALSE)

          row.names = FALSE)
```

### Check P-value Behaviour

#### XtXst estimator

Visualize the estimates of the XtXst differentiation measures.

Check behavior of the p-values associated to the XtXst estimator.

```{r}

  LGL_baypass_setup_info$run_info$seeds,

    ggplot(aes(x = 10**(-1 * log10.1.pval.), y = ..density..)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50, boundary = 0) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1) +

  )

```

##### [OPTIONAL] Correcting for multiple testing

When correcting for multiple testing, p-values should be converted in q-values

Setting FDR (False Discovery Rate) = 0.05 or 0.01

```{r}
LGL_xtx_qvalues <-
  lapply(
    LGL_baypass_setup_info$run_info$seeds,
    \(x) LGL_core_mode_results[["xtx_estimator"]][[x]] %>% 
      mutate(pval =  10**(-1 * log10.1.pval.)) %>% 
      pull(pval) %>% 
      qvalue(fdr.level = 0.05, pfdr = TRUE)
    )
```

```{r}
      cat("\n#####  Seed:", seed, "#####\n")

      LGL_xtx_qvalues                          # corresponding q-value objects
    )
  )
```

### Analyze `Baypass` results

##### Check convergence of the covariance matrix

Calculate correlation between the posterior means of the estimated Omega matrix elements across independent runs.

```{R}
LGL_core_mode_results$lda_omega %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "seed") %>%
  mutate(comparison = paste0(I, " - ", J)) %>% 
  select(comparison, seed, M_omega_ij) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = M_omega_ij) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("comparison") %>% 
  cor() 
```

Visualize covariance matrix using SVD decomposition:

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 15

plot.omega(
  omega = LGL_core_mode_results[["omega_matrix"]][["7357"]],
  pop.names = LGL_core_mode_results[["pop_names"]]
)
```

Visualize covariance matrix as a correlation plot:

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 15

# Convert to correlation matrix
corr_mat <- cov2cor(
  LGL_core_mode_results[["omega_matrix"]][["7357"]]
)

# Plot correlation
corrplot(
  corr_mat,
  method = "color",
  mar = c(2, 1, 2, 2) + 0.1,
  main = expression("Correlation map based on" ~ hat(Omega))
)
```

Visualize covariance matrix as a heatmap:

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 15
heatmap(
  1 - corr_mat,
  hclustfun = \(x) hclust(x, method = "average"),
  main = expression("Heatmap of " ~ hat(Omega) ~ "(" * d[ij] * "=1-" * rho[ij] * ")")
)
```

Visualize covariance matrix as hierarchical clustering tree:

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 15
plot(
  as.phylo(
    hclust(
      as.dist(1 - corr_mat**2)
    )
  ),
  type = "p",
  main = expression(
    "Hier. clust. tree based on" ~ hat(Omega) ~ "(" * d[ij] * "=1-" * rho[ij] * ")"
  )
)
```

#### XtXst estimator

###### XtXst outliers

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 15

LGL_SNP_metadata <- 
  vcf_vcfr_dataset[["LGL"]]@fix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(CHROM, POS) %>% 
  mutate(
    MRK = 1:n(),
    CHROM_number = as.numeric(str_extract(CHROM, "\\d+")),
    CHROM_color = case_when(
      CHROM_number %% 2 == 0 ~ "even",
      TRUE ~ "odd"
    )
  )

names(LGL_POD_xtxst_thresholds) <- as.character(LGL_baypass_setup_info$run_info$seeds)

LGL_xtxst_manhattan_plots <- lapply(
  LGL_baypass_setup_info$run_info$seeds,
  function(seed) {
    # 1. Get BayPass results for this seed
    snp_data <- LGL_core_mode_results[["xtx_estimator"]][[seed]]
    
    # 2. Get corresponding threshold from POD
    threshold <- LGL_POD_xtxst_thresholds[[as.character(seed)]]
    
    # 3. Annotate with outlier flag + SNP metadata
    snp_data <- snp_data %>%
      mutate(
        is_outlier = ifelse(XtXst >= threshold, "outlier", "not outlier")
      ) %>%
      left_join(LGL_SNP_metadata, by = "MRK")
    
    # 4. Manhattan plot
    ggplot(snp_data, aes(x = MRK, y = XtXst, color = CHROM_color, size = is_outlier)) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_hline(yintercept = threshold, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("odd" = "black", "even" = "grey")) +
      scale_size_manual(values = c("outlier" = 2, "not outlier" = 0.5)) +
      labs(
        title = paste("XtXst Manhattan Plot – Seed", seed),
        subtitle = paste("Threshold from POD:", round(threshold, 3)),
        x = "SNP (MRK)",
        y = "XtXst"
      ) +
      guides(color = "none", size = "none") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
  }
)

names(LGL_POD_xtxst_thresholds) <- as.character(LGL_baypass_setup_info$run_info$seeds)

# Print the plots

for (plot in LGL_xtxst_manhattan_plots) {
  print(plot)
}

# Save to a PDF

pdf("03_results/graphs/LGL_XtXst_Manhattan_plots", width = 12, height = 6)

for (p in LGL_xtxst_manhattan_plots) {
  print(p)
}

dev.off()
```

```{r}
    threshold <- LGL_POD_xtxst_thresholds[[seed]]
    real_data <- LGL_core_mode_results$xtx_estimator[[seed]]
    
    real_data %>%
      filter(XtXst >= threshold) %>%
      pull(MRK)  # Pulls the marker IDs

) %>% setNames(names(LGL_POD_xtxst_thresholds))
```

###### Calculate Median XtXst

```{R}
  select(seed, MRK, XtXst) %>% 
  summarise(Median_XtXst = median(XtXst), .by = MRK) %>% 
  mutate(
    is_outlier = ifelse(Median_XtXst >= LGL_POD_xtxst_thresholds[1] , "outlier", "not outlier")
    )
```

###### C2 outliers

Extract outliers by keeping only those above the threshold in every seed.

```{R}
# Open a new PDF device
pdf("03_results/Contrast_analysis/graphs/LGL_C2_statistic_Manhattan_plots_300bp.pdf", width = 15, height = 10)

names(LGL_POD_C2_thresholds)

LGL_SNP_metadata <- 
  vcf_vcfr_dataset[["LGL"]]@fix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(CHROM, POS) %>% 
  mutate(
    MRK = 1:64032,
    CHROM_number = as.numeric(str_extract(CHROM, "\\d+")),
    CHROM_color = case_when(
      CHROM_number %% 2 == 0 ~ "even",
      TRUE ~ "odd"
    )
  )

# Loop through all seeds
invisible(
  lapply(
    LGL_baypass_setup_info$run_info$seeds,
    function(seed) {
      
      # 1. Get C2 data for this seed
      snp_data <- LGL_core_mode_results[["contrast"]][[seed]]
      
      # 2. Get threshold for this seed
      c2_thresh <- LGL_POD_C2_thresholds[[as.character(seed)]]

      # 3. Add outlier flag to SNP table based on M_C2 LGL C2 threshold
      snp_data <- snp_data %>%
        mutate(
            is_outlier = case_when(
            C2 >= c2_thresh ~ "outlier",
            TRUE ~ "not outlier"
  ),
          CONTRAST = as.character(CONTRAST)
        ) %>%
        left_join(LGL_SNP_metadata, by = "MRK") %>%
        left_join(contrast_key, by = "CONTRAST")  # Add contrast names

      # 4. Plot using ContrastName
      print(
        ggplot(snp_data, aes(x = MRK, y = C2, color = CHROM_color, size = is_outlier)) +
          geom_point() +
          geom_hline(yintercept = c2_thresh, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
          scale_color_manual(values = c("odd" = "black", "even" = "grey")) +
          scale_size_manual(values = c("outlier" = 2, "not outlier" = 1)) +
          facet_wrap(~ ContrastName, scales = "free_x", ncol = 1) +  # Use readable names
          labs(
            title = paste("C2 statistic (Seed", seed, ")"),
            x = "SNP (MRK)",
            y = "C2 value"
          ) +
          guides(color = "none", size = "none") +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
      )
    }
  )
)

# Close the PDF device
dev.off()
```

##### BF outliers

```{R}
# Set seed to plot
seed <- "7357"

# BF threshold for decisive evidence (e.g. Jeffreys’ rule)
bf_thresh <- 10

# Read BF values (6 contrasts × N SNPs)
LGL_bf_data <- LGL_core_mode_results$betai_reg[[seed]]$BF.dB.
LGL_n_contrasts <- length(unique(contrast_key$CONTRAST))
LGL_n_snps <- length(LGL_bf_data) / LGL_n_contrasts

# Create tibble with BF per SNP LGL contrast
LGL_BF_df <- tibble(
  MRK = rep(1:LGL_n_snps, times = LGL_n_contrasts),
  CONTRAST = as.character(rep(1:LGL_n_contrasts, each = LGL_n_snps)),
  BF = LGL_bf_data
) %>%
  mutate(
    is_outlier = ifelse(BF >= bf_thresh, "outlier", "not outlier")
  ) %>%
  left_join(LGL_SNP_metadata, by = "MRK") %>%
  left_join(contrast_key, by = "CONTRAST")

# Save to PDF
pdf("03_results/Contrast_analysis/LGL/LGL_BF_statistic_Manhattan_plot_seed7357_300bp.pdf", width = 15, height = 10)

# Plot
print(
  ggplot(LGL_BF_df, aes(x = MRK, y = BF, color = CHROM_color, size = is_outlier)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = bf_thresh, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("odd" = "black", "even" = "grey")) +
    scale_size_manual(values = c("outlier" = 2, "not outlier" = 1)) +
    facet_wrap(~ ContrastName, scales = "free_x", ncol = 1) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Bayes Factor (BF) Statistic – Seed", seed),
      x = "SNP (MRK)",
      y = "BF (dB)"
    ) +
    guides(color = "none", size = "none") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
)

dev.off()
```

```{R}
  paste0("LGL_run_baypass_300bp_seed", seed, "_core_summary_betai_reg.out")
)

LGL_bf_values <- read.table(bf_file, header = TRUE)$BF.dB.
LGL_n_snps <- length(LGL_bf_values)
LGL_n_contrasts <- 3

LGL_BF_table <- tibble(
  MRK = rep(1:(LGL_n_snps / LGL_n_contrasts), times = LGL_n_contrasts),
  CONTRAST = as.character(rep(1:LGL_n_contrasts, each = LGL_n_snps / LGL_n_contrasts)),
  BF = LGL_bf_values
) %>%
  left_join(contrast_key, by = "CONTRAST")

# Load C2 values
LGL_C2_table <- LGL_core_mode_results[["contrast"]][[seed]] %>%
  mutate(
    CONTRAST = as.character(CONTRAST),
    log10p = log10.1.pval.
  ) %>%
  left_join(contrast_key, by = "CONTRAST") %>%
  select(MRK, ContrastName, C2, log10p)

# Combine BF and C2 values
LGL_C2_BF_combined <- LGL_C2_table %>%
  left_join(BF_table, by = c("MRK", "ContrastName"))

# Add outlier flags using empirical threshold
LGL_C2_threshold <- as.numeric(LGL_POD_C2_thresholds[seed])

LGL_C2_BF_combined <- LGL_C2_BF_combined %>%
  mutate(
    C2_outlier = C2 >= LGL_C2_threshold,
    BF_outlier = BF >= 10,
    both_outlier = C2_outlier & BF_outlier
  )

# Optional: extract only double outliers
LGL_C2_BF_outliers_7357 <- LGL_C2_BF_combined %>% filter(both_outlier)

# Plot
plot_path <- "03_results/C2_BF/LGL_seed7357_BF_vs_C2_300bp_plot.pdf"
dir.create(dirname(plot_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggplot(LGL_C2_BF_combined, aes(x = BF, y = C2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = both_outlier), alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ ContrastName, ncol = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = C2_threshold, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 10, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "red", "FALSE" = "black")) +
  labs(
    title = "Bayes Factor vs C2 Statistic",
    subtitle = "Red = Outliers for BOTH BF and C2",
    x = "Bayes Factor (BF in dB)",
    y = "C2 Statistic"
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Outlier (BF & C2)")) +
  theme_minimal()

# Save plot
ggsave(plot_path, width = 10, height = 15)

# Join SNP metadata to include POS and CHROM info
LGL_C2_BF_outliers_7357_position <- LGL_C2_BF_outliers_7357 %>%
  left_join(LGL_SNP_metadata, by = "MRK")

# Save updated CSV
write_csv(LGL_C2_BF_outliers_7357_position, "03_results/C2_BF/LGL_seed7357_C2_BF_300bp_outliers_with_POS.csv")
```

####### Extract common (UNION) C2 x BF outliers between contrasts in a list

```{R}
# Load main outlier table
LGL_C2_BF_total_outliers <- read_csv("03_results/C2_BF/LGL_seed7357_C2_BF_300bp_outliers.csv")

# Split by contrast
split_outliers <- split(LGL_C2_BF_total_outliers, LGL_C2_BF_total_outliers$ContrastName)

# Define helper function to merge LGL clean columns
# Helper to get common outliers LGL clean up column names
LGL_extract_C2_BF_total_outliers <- function(df1, df2) {
  inner_join(df1, df2, by = "MRK", suffix = c(".1", ".2")) %>%
    transmute(
      MRK,
      ContrastName = ContrastName.1,
      C2 = C2.1,
      log10p = log10p.1,
      BF = BF.1,
      C2_outlier = C2_outlier.1,
      BF_outlier = BF_outlier.1,
      both_outlier = both_outlier.1
    )
}

# Compute pairwise intersections
LGL_UNION_C2_BF_outlier_C1_C2  <- LGL_extract_C2_BF_total_outliers(split_outliers[[1]], split_outliers[[2]])
LGL_UNION_C2_BF_outlier_C1_C3 <- LGL_extract_C2_BF_total_outliers(split_outliers[[1]], split_outliers[[3]])
LGL_UNION_C2_BF_outlier_C2_C3 <- LGL_extract_C2_BF_total_outliers(split_outliers[[2]], split_outliers[[3]])

# Export as CSV
write_csv(LGL_UNION_C2_BF_outlier_C1_C2, "03_results/C2_BF/LGL_C2_BF_common_outliers_C1_C2.csv")
write_csv(LGL_UNION_C2_BF_outlier_C1_C3, "03_results/C2_BF/LGL_C2_BF_common_outliers_C1_C3.csv")
write_csv(LGL_UNION_C2_BF_outlier_C2_C3, "03_results/C2_BF/LGL_C2_BF_common_outliers_C2_C3.csv")
```

#### Compute Local Scores

```{R}
# Set seed LGL contrast
seed <- "7357"
contrast_id <- "3"  # Use "1", "2", or "3"

# 1. SNP position info
LGL_snp_position <- LGL_SNP_metadata %>%
  select(CHROM, POS) %>%
  mutate(POS = as.numeric(POS)) %>%
  arrange(POS)

# 2. Extract pi values (from summary_pi_xtx.out)
LGL_snp_pi <- LGL_core_mode_results$xtx_estimator[[seed]]$M_P

# 3. Extract p-values (from summary_contrast.out)
LGL_snp_pvalues <- LGL_core_mode_results$contrast[[seed]] %>%
  filter(CONTRAST == contrast_id) %>%
  pull(log10.1.pval.)

# 4. Compute local scores (LGL plot)
pdf(paste0("03_results/Local_scores/LGL_local_scores_contrast_", contrast_id, "_seed", seed, "_300bp.pdf"),
    width = 10, height = 6)

LGL_local_scores <- compute.local.scores(
  snp.position = LGL_snp_position,
  snp.pi = LGL_snp_pi,
  snp.pvalue = LGL_snp_pvalues,
  manplot = TRUE,
  min.maf = 0.20,
  xi = 4,
  min.nsnp = 0,
  plot.pvalhist = TRUE
)

 # Save output tables from compute.local.scores
 write.csv(LGL_local_scores$res.local.scores,
          file = paste0("03_results/Local_scores/LGL_local_scores_contrast_", contrast_id, "_seed", seed, "_res_local_scores.csv"),
         row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(LGL_local_scores$significant.windows,
          file = paste0("03_results/Local_scores/LGL_local_scores_contrast_", contrast_id, "_seed", seed, "_significant_windows.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)


dev.off()
```
